question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s consolidated authority within the Chinese Communist Party, reinforced through extended anti-corruption campaigns that have removed potential rivals from military and senior party ranks, underpins the 95.5% trader consensus against removal before the end of 2026. With no designated successor elevated and generational norms already altered after his third term, the 21st Party Congress in 2027 remains the expected venue for a fourth term rather than transition. Public appearances, diplomatic activity, and policy continuity through mid-2026 signal stable elite alignment around continued leadership. Low-probability shifts could still arise from abrupt health developments, severe economic disruptions that fracture institutional support, or unexpected rifts within party structures ahead of the congress.

question: Will Gavin Newsom win the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination?
description:

eventMetadata.context_description: The fragmented 2028 Democratic field remains wide open with no formal declarations, sustaining tight trader pricing among Gavin Newsom, Jon Ossoff, and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez.
